info.name: Student ID - Server Rules Service
info.description: Server Rules lab3-0.4.1: run this collection in order through Gateway http://localhost:8090. Set a valid accessToken accepted by the team's Gateway in a private local environment; never commit tokens or keys. Creates a uniquely named disposable rule, verifies CRUD/current/evaluate and deletion, then checks invalid requests. Version assertions are relative, not hard-coded to an empty database. Internal /status and controlled database failures are not tested here. This collection does not establish shared-stack acceptance or live transport for the in-process fixtures.

exec: pm.test('No server-side failure or false green', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.below(500));

variable.description: Disposable local test JWT. Set in a private local environment; keep this collection value empty.

exec: pm.test('Rule created with an ID', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const id = pm.response.json().ruleId; pm.expect(id).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('ruleId', id); });

body.raw:
{
  "code": "{{ruleCode}}",
  "description": "Must be enrolled for at least 2 years",
  "type": "MIN_ENROLLMENT_YEARS",
  "severity": "MAJOR",
  "active": true,
  "minimumYears": 2
}

exec: pm.test('Listing contains created rule', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().rules.some(r => r.ruleId === pm.collectionVariables.get('ruleId'))).to.eql(true); });

body.raw:
{
  "code": "{{ruleCode}}",
  "description": "Must be enrolled for at least 2 years",
  "type": "MIN_ENROLLMENT_YEARS",
  "severity": "MAJOR",
  "active": true,

exec: pm.test('Current snapshot contains created rule and a version', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.rulesetVersion).to.be.a('number').and.at.least(1); pm.expect(body.rules.some(r => r.code === pm.collectionVariables.get('ruleCode'))).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Evaluation uses the updated rule', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.rulesetVersion).to.be.a('number').and.at.least(1); pm.expect(body.violations.some(v => v.code === pm.collectionVariables.get('ruleCode') && v.severity === 'MAJOR')).to.eql(true); });
